paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom) on 5-digit multiplication.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy of two language models, Llama4 Scout and Llama4 Maverick, as a function of initial confidence. The x-axis represents Initial Confidence, with a linear scale ranging from 0.95 to 0.99, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis represents Accuracy, ranging from 0.6 to 1.0 with tick marks every 0.2.  The blue solid line represents the Final Accuracy for Llama4 Scout, starting at a value of approximately 0.88 and gradually increasing to around 0.90. A dashed orange line represents the Delta Accuracy for Llama4 Scout, beginning at approximately 0.06 and increasing to roughly 0.08.  A green dashed-dotted line represents the Initial Accuracy for Llama4 Scout, starting at approximately 0.78 and ending at approximately 0.80.  The red solid line represents the Final Accuracy for Llama4 Maverick, beginning at approximately 0.96 and reaching a value of approximately 0.98. A dashed yellow line represents the Delta Accuracy for Llama4 Maverick, starting at approximately 0.04 and reaching a value of approximately 0.06. A green dashed-dotted line represents the Initial Accuracy for Llama4 Maverick, starting at approximately 0.89 and ending at roughly 0.90.
